heroHeadline: Ebola Transit Centre Burns Down in Ituri Camp as DRC Toll Reaches 3,924 Deaths
heroSubtitle: An Ebola transit centre at Kigonze camp in Ituri, sheltering about 19,000 displaced people, burned down on Sept 30 and the camp was abandoned. DRC has reported 8,116 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,924 deaths as of Sept 28. Government forces and M23 continue fighting despite peace agreements, as the Security Council warned on Sept 29.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
